_README: Central-bank stance, MAINTAINED BY HAND. Rates move 4-8 times a year, so a
hand-kept file beats a scraper and never breaks.
FILL THIS IN YOURSELF, from each bank's own site or a rates table you trust.
Every 'stance' ships as null on purpose: the brief withholds all rate leans
until you have set real values AND set "verified": true. That is not
bureaucracy — a lean computed off numbers nobody checked is worse than no
lean, because it feels like information.
allowed stance values, most currency-positive first:
hiking | hawkish | hawkish_hold | neutral | dovish_hold | dovish | cutting
Update after each FOMC / ECB / BOE / RBNZ decision, re-stamp last_verified,
and copy this file to data/cb_stance.json (which is the one actually read).
